# CoreForge
> 360° Digital Marketing, Brand Strategy & Custom Software Engineering | Precision Technology Solutions

## Overview
CoreForge is a digital marketing and custom software engineering firm headquartered in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India. Founded in October 2024, CoreForge specializes in 360° Digital Marketing & Brand Strategy, and Custom Web & Mobile Software Engineering, alongside supplying an industrial catalogue of antenna and RF communication hardware.

## Core Practice: 360° Digital Marketing & Software Engineering (/services)

### [360° Digital Marketing & Branding](https://www.coreforgeindia.com/services/digital-marketing-branding)
Data-driven digital marketing, brand positioning frameworks, technical SEO, and multi-channel customer acquisition architectures managed from Bengaluru.

**Capabilities & Sub-services:**
- **Brand Strategy & Identity**: Comprehensive brand positioning frameworks, typographic scale design, logo guidelines, and unified visual identity systems.
- **Website Design & Development**: Headless, high-performance websites engineered with React, Vite, and modern CSS for sub-second load times and high conversion rates.
- **Digital Marketing & Advertising**: Data-driven paid media campaigns across Google Search, Meta Ads, LinkedIn, and programmatic display targeting verified ROI metrics.
- **Social Media Management**: B2B and B2C brand growth across LinkedIn, Instagram, X, and YouTube with consistent technical storytelling and community moderation.
- **Creative Design & Graphic Designing**: Precision digital and print graphic design: pitch decks, product datasheets, packaging, corporate reports, and marketing collateral.
- **Video Production & Content Creation**: Script-to-screen video production including hardware product demos, software walkthroughs, corporate profiles, and 3D motion graphics.
- **Search Engine Optimisation (SEO)**: Technical on-page, architecture, and backlink strategies designed to capture high-intent commercial keywords organically.
- **Influencer & PR Marketing**: Strategic technical influencer partnerships, media releases, and digital PR amplification to establish industry authority.
- **Marketing Automation**: Automated nurture workflows, email drip sequences, lead scoring, and CRM pipeline triggers using HubSpot, ActiveCampaign, and custom webhooks.
- **Business Growth & Consulting**: Go-to-market roadmaps, pricing models, CAC optimization, and unit economics validation for tech startups and emerging enterprises.

### [Software & App Development](https://www.coreforgeindia.com/services/software-app-development)
Full-lifecycle software engineering from architecture design and database modeling to cloud deployment, mobile apps, and SLA-backed maintenance.

**Capabilities & Sub-services:**
- **Website Development**: High-speed corporate portals and conversion websites built with React, Vite, and Next.js, optimized for zero layout shift and sub-second TTFB.
- **Web Application Development**: Complex web applications featuring real-time state, role-based access control, interactive dashboards, and scalable database backends.
- **Android & iOS App Development**: Cross-platform and native mobile applications with offline storage, background push notifications, hardware Bluetooth/GPS integration, and app store compliance.
- **Custom Software Development**: Bespoke software engines tailored to proprietary business logic, eliminating generic SaaS limitations and recurring licensing costs.
- **ERP & CRM Solutions**: Enterprise resource planning, inventory control, purchase order tracking, and CRM sales pipelines engineered for manufacturing and logistics.
- **SaaS Product Development**: End-to-end multi-tenant SaaS architecture with automated subscription billing, user tenant isolation, analytics, and self-service onboarding.
- **API Development & Integration**: High-throughput REST and GraphQL APIs, third-party payment gateway links, webhook consumers, and legacy enterprise system connectors.
- **AI & Business Automation**: Intelligent document extraction, automated customer support assistants, OCR processing, and predictive analytics integrated into existing workflows.
- **Database Management Solutions**: Relational and NoSQL database modeling, query index optimization, zero-downtime migrations, and automated high-availability clustering.
- **Cloud, Server & Hosting Solutions**: Cloud architecture sizing, Kubernetes orchestration, automated Docker pipelines, and cost-optimized infrastructure on AWS, GCP, and Cloudflare.
- **Cybersecurity & IT Solutions**: Application security testing, penetration test reports, vulnerability remediation, SSL hardening, and OWASP Top 10 compliance audits.
- **Software Maintenance & Technical Support**: SLA-guaranteed uptime monitoring, patch deployment, dependency upgrades, bug fixes, and continuous technical enhancements.

## Auxiliary Hardware Supply: Antenna & RF Communication Products (/products)

### [Antenna Systems](https://www.coreforgeindia.com/products/antennas)
High-reliability antenna systems engineered for harsh environments, base station communications, vehicle tracking, marine telemetry, and IoT wireless networks.

**Engineered Hardware Lines:**
- **VHF / UHF Base Station & Mobile Antennas** (136 - 174 MHz (VHF) / 380 - 470 MHz (UHF)): Heavy-duty collinear omnidirectional and directional Yagi antennas covering VHF (136-174 MHz) and UHF (380-470 MHz) commercial and public safety bands.
- **GSM / LTE / 4G / 5G Cellular Antennas** (698 - 960 MHz & 1710 - 2700 MHz (Broadband)): Broadband cellular antennas in magnetic mount, rubber duck, and low-profile puck configurations supporting GSM 900/1800, 3G, 4G LTE, and sub-6 GHz 5G.
- **Wi-Fi / WLAN Dual-Band Antennas** (2400 - 2500 MHz & 5150 - 5850 MHz): High-gain dual-band 2.4 GHz and 5.8 GHz Wi-Fi antennas in omnidirectional rubber duck, ceiling dome, directional panel, and cone configurations.
- **GPS / GNSS Active & Passive Antennas** (Industrial Grade): Precision active GPS L1, GLONASS, and Galileo reception antennas with integrated low-noise amplifier (LNA) for vehicle tracking and marine navigation.
- **Log-Periodic & Wideband Antennas** (400 MHz to 6.0 GHz (Continuous broadband)): Broadband directional log-periodic dipole arrays (LPA) covering wide spectrums for EMC testing, surveillance, and multi-band telemetry.
- **UHF RFID Reader Antennas** (865 - 868 MHz (India/EU) / 902 - 928 MHz (US FCC)): Circularly polarized UHF RFID reader panel antennas for automated warehouse inventory, asset tracking portals, and logistics gates.

### [RF Passive Components](https://www.coreforgeindia.com/products/rf-passive-components)
Precision machined RF passive hardware delivering ultra-low insertion loss, high power handling, and sharp out-of-band rejection.

**Engineered Hardware Lines:**
- **High-Q RF Cavity Duplexers** (136 - 174 MHz (VHF) / 380 - 470 MHz (UHF)): Precision CNC-machined cavity duplexers for VHF and UHF repeater base stations providing superior TX/RX frequency isolation.
- **Directional Couplers & Power Taps** (698 - 2700 MHz (Broadband)): Low PIM broad-band directional couplers for signal monitoring, transmitter power reflection measurement, and distributed antenna systems.
- **Power Splitters & Combiners** (698 - 3800 MHz (Covers 4G & 5G bands)): 2-Way, 3-Way, and 4-Way reactive power dividers for multi-antenna transmitter feeds and cellular coverage distribution.
- **RF Coaxial Fixed Attenuators** (DC to 3.0 GHz / DC to 6.0 GHz): Precision continuous power RF attenuators engineered for test equipment protection, power leveling, and impedance matching.
- **Cavity Band Pass Filters** (Industrial Grade): Narrowband and wideband cavity filters providing steep skirt selectivity and deep rejection of out-of-band interference.

### [RF Cables & Connectivity](https://www.coreforgeindia.com/products/rf-cables-connectivity)
Mil-spec and industrial grade low-loss RF coaxial cable assemblies, phase-stable jumper cables, and adapters tested 100% on Vector Network Analyzers.

**Engineered Hardware Lines:**
- **Low-Loss RF Coaxial Cable Assemblies** (Industrial Grade): Custom length coaxial cables (LMR-400, LMR-200, RG-58, RG-174, RG-213) terminated with precision gold and silver plated connectors.
- **RF Lightning & Surge Protectors** (DC to 3.0 GHz / DC to 6.0 GHz): Gas discharge tube coaxial lightning protectors shielding base stations and transceivers against electrical surges and direct lightning strikes.
